words.gloss: at the time / like the moment
she who has locks of hair

literal: Like those very things at the moment they are desired, indeed resemble the shoulders of her who has flower-adorned hair.
translation: The shoulders of my beloved, whose hair is adorned with flower petals, are like those objects of desire that yield fresh and exquisite pleasure every single time they are enjoyed.
modern: பூவிதழ்கள் அணிந்த கூந்தலை உடையவளின் தோள்கள், நாம் விரும்பிய காலத்தில் அனுபவிக்கும் அந்தந்த இன்பப் பொருட்களைப் போல எப்போதும் புதிய இன்பத்தைத் தருகின்றன.
explanation: In this couplet, the lover expresses how the embrace of his beloved never grows old. He compares her shoulders to things that are intensely desired; just as those things bring fresh, unmatched joy every time they are experienced at the right moment, her shoulders offer a novel pleasure with every embrace. The phrase 'தோட்டார் கதுப்பினாள்' describes the beloved as one with flower-adorned hair, adding a sensory layer of fragrance and beauty to the imagery. The repetition of 'அவை அவை' (those very things) emphasizes the diverse and ever-renewing nature of these pleasures.
